posts.title: SEBI Extends Digital Accessibility Audit and Remediation Deadline to October 31, 2026
posts.description: SEBI has extended the timeline for regulated entities to complete digital accessibility audits and remediate findings from those audits. In a circular issued on July 31, 2026, SEBI extended the timeline for the conduct of accessibility audits for digital platforms and remediation of findings from the audit until October 31, 2026.
